data.description: Discovered in AS-7 first-fire ops verification (2026-08-30): the watcher fired correctly for messageId 120, but the spawned tick died in ~2s with 'Not logged in - Please run /login'. Diagnosis (orchestrator-verified via env -i tests): claude auth on this host is macOS-Keychain-based and requires USER in the process environment; the watcher's child env is exactly {PATH, HOME} per the AS-7 plan's minimal-env rule — one variable too strict. 'env -i HOME=... USER=... PATH=... claude -p' works; without USER it reproduces the failure. THE FIX: apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs, fire(), child env construction (currently 'env: { PATH: process.env.PATH, HOME: process.env.HOME }', line ~371) — add USER, and consider LOGNAME for the same keychain/identity reason. Do NOT widen further: the minimal-env principle stands, and each added variable needs a stated reason. Also update the comment above the spawn call to record why USER is present. Tests: apps/chat/test/watcher.test.js does not currently assert child env contents (verified by grep), but Priya's AS-7 review verified 'child env exactly {PATH, HOME}' from source — that pin is now stale and must be understood as {PATH, HOME, USER(, LOGNAME)}; if any assertion pinning the env exists or is added, it pins the new set. Priority high: this blocks the chat app as the board's primary interface — every message-triggered tick dies at auth until fixed.
data.title: advance-watcher: pass USER (keychain auth) in tick child env

data.body: Planning done (CTO, self-planned — fully-specified bug from AS-7 first-fire ops). Plan: add USER and LOGNAME to the fire() spawn env in apps/chat/watch/advance-watcher.mjs (currently exactly {PATH, HOME}); claude's macOS-Keychain auth needs USER to resolve the login keychain, LOGNAME is its POSIX twin. Widen no further; document the reason at the spawn site. watcher.test.js pins nothing about child env today (grep-verified) — any assertion added pins the new four-variable set. Acceptance criteria in plan file. Branch feat/AS-14-watcher-user-env linked.

Implementation done (commit 4500cc4 on feat/AS-14-watcher-user-env). fire() child env widened to exactly {PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME}, extracted into exported tickChildEnv() so the set is unit-pinned — new test asserts extras (SHELL, TMPDIR, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, etc.) do NOT leak and the key set is stable on a thin launchd env. Spawn-site comment now states each variable's reason (USER: macOS Keychain login-keychain resolution; LOGNAME: POSIX twin) and restates the every-addition-needs-a-reason rule. No other watcher behavior touched. Suite in-container: 92/92 (was 91). Note for ops (per plan): host watcher NOT restarted — that's the board's process; fix takes effect on next watcher restart, and messageId 120's failed tick will not auto-retry by design.

REVIEW (qa-priya, cold): PASS — no rework needed, no inline fixes. Inputs: plan file, AS-14 comments, git diff master...feat/AS-14-watcher-user-env read cold, container suite run myself, host-node attack probes.

SUITE: DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 COMPOSE_DOCKER_CLI_BUILD=1 docker compose run --rm --build test -> 92 pass / 0 fail (was 91; +1 = new tickChildEnv pin test). Note: without the BuildKit env vars the run fails on the documented arm64-vs-amd64 platform pin — compose.yaml header covers this; not a finding.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (plan, 4/4):
1. PASS — spawn env is exactly {PATH, HOME, USER, LOGNAME} from process.env: fire() now uses env: tickChildEnv(process.env); the function returns only those four keys, nothing else added (source + test verified).
2. PASS — spawn-site comment gives a per-variable reason for all four (PATH locate binaries, HOME config dir, USER keychain identity w/ the 2s not-logged-in symptom, LOGNAME POSIX twin) and restates the each-addition-needs-a-reason rule.
3. PASS — full chat suite green in-container (stronger than the criterion's watcher-file minimum).
4. PASS — no other behavior change: diff touches only tickChildEnv extraction + comment + spawn line in advance-watcher.mjs, one test + import in watcher.test.js, and lattice bookkeeping. Extraction is behavior-identical at the spawn site modulo the intended widening.

ATTACK RESULTS (all pass):
- Leak probe: fed tickChildEnv a fat env containing FAKE_SECRET, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, SSH_AUTH_SOCK, ANTHROPIC_MODEL — none present in output; key set exactly the four.
- Test-can-fail check (mutation): a leaky impl ({...env}) fails the deepEqual(strict) assertion (extra keys detected); a narrowed impl (drops LOGNAME) fails the key-set assertion. The new test is a real pin, not a tautology.
- Absent-USER / thin-launchd case: tickChildEnv({}) yields the four keys with undefined values; verified empirically (node v24, spawnSync /usr/bin/env) that Node OMITS undefined-valued keys from the child env — no 'USER=undefined' stringification. Absent USER degrades exactly to pre-fix behavior, never a corrupt value.

EVIDENCE FOR THE WIDENING: my AS-7 review pinned 'child env exactly {PATH, HOME}'; that pin is superseded on the board's first-fire evidence (env -i repro: with USER claude -p works, without it dies 'Not logged in'). USER earns its place; LOGNAME is the sanctioned POSIX twin per task description and plan. Minimal-env principle survives with reasons attached, and is now unit-pinned so future drift is a deliberate two-file change. No new leak surface: USER/LOGNAME are identity, not secrets.

PHILOSOPHY check: zero external calls, zero spend.

RECOMMENDATION: meets all acceptance criteria; orchestrator may move AS-14 to done and merge. Ops residual (out of scope per plan): watcher restart + next human message verifies end-to-end; AS-7 checklist items 3/4 still pending board-side.
